transcript.text: Samsung WW90T534DAW keeps coming up with 4C after a couple of minutes. Drum is dry. Any ideas before I call someone out?

4C on your Samsung means: Water supply issue - little or no water entering (tap/pressure/inlet mesh/hose). From what you have described, the most likely cause is property / local cold-water supply. Next: Check the other cold taps in the property before suspecting the appliance. Let me know what you find.
Kitchen cold tap has normal pressure. Is there anything else I should check?

Before you start, switch it off and unplug it. From what you have described, the most likely cause is blocked inlet mesh / filter. Where the fill hose screws onto the back of the machine there's a small mesh filter that can block with grit or scale. Unscrew the hose at the machine end and look into the inlet. Was the mesh blocked (and is it clean now), or was it already clean?
Mesh filter was clogged with grey grit and limescale bits. I've cleaned it and refitted the hose, and it fills normally now, 4C has gone.
Good news, that has sorted it. If it happens again, start with the same check. Is there anything else I can help with?
